scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The structural proof is self-contained and the finite decoder census is independently replayable from the packaged verifier. Literature comparisons distinguish a displayed canonical example from an exhaustive equality classification.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: Exactly four messages, two writes, binary cells, and a generation-independent interpretation function; full update functions and larger WOM parameters are not classified.

title: Rigidity of the three-cell Rivest–Shamir WOM decoder
